Clustering Without Knowing How To: Application and Evaluation

paper.arxiv.2209.10267

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2209.10267v3. Worker grouping/color-label method and lack of unique style ground truth establish annotation/aggregation scope; only the selected clothing demonstration is represented. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Style clustering lacks one uniquely correct gold grouping, so the evaluation measures consistency with other workers’ subjective judgments using intruders rather than recovery of an objective class truth.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The system asks three workers per task to group small sets of clothing images by style using palette labels, then aggregates sparse judgments with a reimplemented probabilistic Crowdclustering model whose cluster count is estimated dynamically.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Experiments used 2, 000 FEIDEGGER dress images and 87 Toloka Shoes images; workers completed progressive five-page training and a qualification test, requiring at least 80 out of 100 to advance.
